Negatives are the fenced siblings: what-to-build documents (prd-/spec-/lld-/adr-author, make-reference) and the non-argument genres the craft doc backs off from (marketing, tutorial, status/report, neutral balanced analysis), PLUS the review-intent boundary negative ('review this vision memo against its rubric' → doc-checker independently critiques; this seat authors and self-evaluates — the maker≠critic split). The thesis-missing case (legacy eval #5, 'write about why documentation is important') is a BEHAVIOR test, not a routing case — the skill routes here but then asks for a thesis before drafting; see SKILL.md Step 2.
